intro.narration: Inside the computer shop. The fan hums, and so do everyone's nerves. JR still has his headset on.

intro.speaker: jr_hotshot
intro.text: Sup. I'm JR, rank one here. You're the one grinding through story mode? Cute.

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: Apo. I'm just here to watch what you've learned.

intro.speaker: jr_hotshot
intro.text: Lolo?! Legend. But relax, tito, I don't need coaching. I scripted this deal, GG already.

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: Scripted? In our day, the cards did the beating. The excuses came later.

intro.speaker: jr_hotshot
intro.text: Boomer take, respect. But look at this, perfect hand, meta build.

intro.narration: JR dealt the cards, grinning. You looked at your hand. The three of clubs, and two four-of-a-kinds.

intro.speaker: jr_hotshot
intro.text: Wait. What are you holding? Hold on, was that a misdeal? That's lag, doesn't count!

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: Oh no. Looks like you got nerfed, and my apo here is holding the real script.

intro.speaker: jr_hotshot
intro.text: Okay okay, quiet sweatlord, respect. But this isn't over. I can still clutch.

win.speaker: jr_hotshot
win.text: You're out?! Impossible, you had quads?! That's rigged, I'm reporting this to the admin!

win.speaker: lolo_carding
win.text: There's no admin at the table, apo. Only winners and losers.

win.narration: JR pulled off his headset. For the first time, the whole shop went silent.

win.speaker: jr_hotshot
win.text: ...okay. GG. You're legit. You don't stream? Too bad, you'd go viral.

lose.speaker: jr_hotshot
lose.text: EZ! GG WP! Clip that, the skill gap is real!

lose.speaker: lolo_carding
lose.text: Hmp. The script gets lucky sometimes. Come back, apo.

lose.speaker: jr_hotshot
lose.text: Rematch anytime, tito. Practice in unranked first, hehe.

lines.speaker: jr_hotshot
lines.text: FOUR OF A KIND?! What build is that?! That's not even in the meta!

lines.speaker: lolo_carding
lines.text: It was in the meta back in 1987, apo.

lines.speaker: jr_hotshot
lines.text: Cleared again? That's server lag. No way that's skill.
